## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The commentary is **indispensable for reading the *Wénzǐ*** — the principal ancient scholarly apparatus and the primary witness to the Táng interpretive tradition on the text. Together with Dù Dàojiān's *[Wénzǐ zuǎn yì](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5c/KR5c0119)* (c. 1290), it constitutes the core classical commentary tradition on the *Wénzǐ*.

**Dating.** Xú Língfǔ's active period is attested as **c. 809–815** (the Yuán hé era). Per the project's dating rule, the frontmatter gives **809–815** as the composition window. Dynasty: 唐.
